authorityRules: The official product page owns product identity, SKU, published dimensions, categories, description, and its hosted representation.
Printed text visible in the publisher-hosted representation may be packaged as publisher evidence.
A category label is not mission or scoring authority.
A representation does not authorize semantics that are not printed or otherwise published.
Publisher representations are preserved as evidence, not as recreated target artwork.
